'''2018 Worlds Day 2 Matt Carulli LS They Have No Idea We're Coming''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Matt Carulli]] at [[2018 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Matt Carulli]]
* '''Event:''' [[2018 World Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|They Have No Idea We're Coming / Until We Win, Or The Chances Are Spent|V9-L-theyhavenoideawerecoming.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2018-world-championships/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210127123938/https://www.starwarsccg.org/2018-world-championships/ Internet Archive]
